an5.27:1.4: āyatiñca → āyatiṁ ca (bj, sya-all) | paccattaññeva → paccattaṁ yeva (bj)
an5.27:1.6: paccattaññeva → paccattaṁ yeva (bj) | akāpurisasevito’ti → mahāpurisasevitoti (cck: ka.)
an5.27:1.7: sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritagatoti paccattaññeva → ca sasaṁkhāraniggayhavāritavatoti paccattaṁ yeva (bj) | sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritagatoti → saṅkhāraniggayhavāritagatoti (cck); ca sasaṁkhāraniggayhavāritappattoti (sya-all) | paṭippassaddhaladdho → paṭippassaddhiladdho (sya-all) | paṭippassaddhaladdho → paṭippassaddhiladdho (bj: syā) | sasaṁkhāraniggayhavāritavato’ti → na ca sasaṁkhāraniggayha vātapattoti (syā); na sasaṁkhāra niggayha cāriyādhihatoti (machasaṁ(?)); na ca sasaṁkhāra niggayha cāritapapatitoti (sīmu) (bj note) | saṅkhāraniggayhavāritagato’ti → na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritappatitoti (sī.), na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritapattoti (syā.), na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayhavārivāvaṭoti (ka.), na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāriyādhigatoti (?) dī. ni. 3.355; a. ni. 3.102; 9.27 (cck note)
an5.27:1.8: sato → so (bj, sya-all) | imaṁ → imaṁ samādhiṁ sato va (bj); imaṁ samādhiṁ satova (sya-all) | vuṭṭhahāmīti paccattaññeva → va uṭṭhahāmīti paccattaṁ yeva (bj) | uṭṭhahāmī’ti → sato kho panāhaṁ imaṁ samāpajjāmi, sato uṭṭhahāmīti (bj: machasaṁ); satoca samapajjāmi sato uṭṭhāhāmīti (bj: syā) | vuṭṭhahāmī’ti → so kho panāhaṁ imaṁ samādhiṁ satova samāpajjāmi, sato uṭṭhahāmīti (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ.)
